data.body: Resume update after expanded file_impact verification: `tests/unit/metrics/test_dead_values_heldout_7504.py` is in the ticket impact list and the worktree already has the requested guard shape: only `commit_cadence_trend` remains guarded as a freed ID; `module_size_trend` and `cap_change_events` are claimed by the implementation. Plan-review status is still current/certified. Local targeted metrics/CLI tests passed (38 passed). Gerrit change 2602 is at patchset 6 with the same tree as the local rebased worktree and LLM-Review +1, but Verified is not green. Current trusted-main CI failures are outside this leaf: scanner-integration fails before contract tests with `ERROR: could not execute .tools/review-scanners/bin/semgrep: [Errno 2] No such file or directory`, and Ubuntu py3.11/py3.12 report `tests/unit/test_api_surface_gate.py` drift for `rebar.KNOWN_ERROR_CODES` that does not reproduce locally on the same tree (`pytest -q tests/unit/test_api_surface_gate.py` passes, 18 passed). These require files outside this ticket's file_impact, so I am stopping per protocol rather than expanding scope or using force.
